info.title: FEXDI X IFSE 2026 — player API
info.description:
Generated by tools/openapi-gen.php from the running router, the controllers'
validate() rules, and a live probe of GET responses. Do not edit by hand: the
hand-written contract drifted, which is why this file exists.

Semantics a schema cannot carry — that submit stays open after time_expired, that
fun_game answers score zero, the minimum interval between position posts — live in
APK-BUILD-GUIDE.md and still have to be read.
